title: Chapter 240 Breaking Through From Three Sides
content:
Chapter 240 Breaking Through From Three Sides

The quality of the alien army is extremely high, the command is orderly, and the speed of action is very fast. Even if they are constantly attacked by the Zerg destroyers, they can still quickly organize the army into three groups and break out in the east, south and north.

"They are going to break out! First destroy their siege weapons, then attack the crossbowmen!"

Wu Qing is well aware of the battlefield intelligence. Hundreds of four-star Zerg hosts are flying in the sky, and all details on the battlefield cannot escape the eyes of the Zerg.

When the aliens did not break out, the Zerg destroyers would attack wherever there were more troops.

Now that the enemy wants to break out, Wu Qing has to take care of the armies of other races in the local camp, and first destroy the long-range attack weapons and troops in the alien army to reduce the defense pressure of the local army.

Regardless of whether it is a pity or not, in order to prevent the alien army from running away, the powerful firepower of the Zerg destroyers finally covered the siege weapons and logistics combat supplies area in the alien army.

In the fierce explosion, those well-made and expensive siege weapons were shattered!

A large number of crossbows, energy crystals, and luxurious military rations and other logistical combat supplies were destroyed in the terrible explosion!

The Zerg destroyers destroyed the siege weapons and some logistical combat supplies of the alien human army, and then turned their attention to the three breakout troops of the alien human army that were forming, and intensively attacked the human crossbowmen among them.

"Bring out all the long-range weapons! We must hold on!"

"The powerful friendly forces are attacking the long-range arms of the alien human army! Everyone's formation should be more dense! Even if we die, we must use our bodies to block the evil god army and never allow them to escape from us!"

"Fame or disgrace! It depends on this time! Everyone cheer up!"

"..."

The armies of various races in the local camp are boosting morale and conducting the final mobilization.

The formation of the alien army's three-way breakout is already very obvious. Whether they can withstand the fierce attack of the alien breakout troops is the key to the success or failure of this encirclement and annihilation battle.

This opportunity is rare. The army of each race is unwilling to be outdone by others. This is a rare opportunity to become famous.

The firepower of the Zerg destroyers was attracted by siege weapons and long-range arms, which gave the other alien troops time to prepare quickly. The three breakout troops moved very quickly and almost simultaneously launched a charge at the local camp army that was waiting for battle.

The limited number of long-range arms and human mages in the three alien breakout troops provided long-range support to the charging melee troops.

"Pay attention to defense! It doesn't matter how many enemies you kill! Just defend! Don't let the enemy pass! That's victory!"

"Raise the shield! Hold the gun! Make good use of obstacles!"

"Fight the ranged troops to death!"

"Those who still have ammunition for siege weapons, use them all!"

"Don't fight hard with melee troops! Defend to the death! Victory is victory!"

"..."

Some commanders of the local camp army, who were fierce in temperament, shouted loudly to command the army to fight, and their voices were loud and spread far away.

The two sides finally fought together, and the long-range attacks such as arrow rain, javelin, magic and a small number of siege weapons in the local camp army kept crossing in the air and fell into the enemy's army phalanx, causing a large number of casualties.

The melee troops of both sides fought hard, and the spearmen, swordsmen and other main melee troops of the alien army, with the blessing of the priests accompanying the army, fought hard to fight forward and kill the enemy.

The melee soldiers of the local camp army, led by shield soldiers and spearmen, focused on defending the attacks of the melee soldiers of the alien army. With the blessing of various luck secrets, their strength alone is not much weaker than the melee soldiers of the alien army.

While attacking hard and defending desperately, both sides have the faith and courage to do whatever it takes.

The breakout battle of the alien army was a full-strength attack from the beginning, and the two sides fought very fiercely.

The defense line of the local camp army was fully prepared, and for a time it was evenly matched with the alien army, which blocked the assault operations of the three breakout troops of the alien.

"Speed up the advancement!"

Wu Qing said to the Queen of the Zerg.

Many specific commands of the Zerg army on the battlefield are all in the charge of the Queen of the Zerg. The Queen of the Zerg can accurately control every Zerg combat unit, and every Zerg is it.

The ground forces of the Zerg army have quickly advanced into the encirclement formed by the local camp army. With the assistance of the Zerg flying dragon group, there is no need to stop to clear the remaining enemies of the infantry square of the alien army. They just rush forward all the way.

"The main force of the alien army is in the east, attack the breakout troops in the east first!"

Wu Qing has been asking the special Zerg host to keep an eye on the command team of the alien army. If the alien army still has a trump card, it will definitely be in this team.

Therefore, the local camp army responsible for blocking the breakout of the alien army in the east is in a very dangerous situation.

The Zerg destroyers, which have basically covered the firepower of the alien crossbowmen, began to focus on the nearly one million alien troops breaking out to the east.

"Boom boom...!"

After a round of attacks by the Zerg destroyers, the alien army still suffered serious casualties even though it tried to disperse its formation.

There was only one location that was not affected by the Zerg Destroyer's attack. The rich light energy there formed a powerful protective shield with a very large coverage area. Even the attack of the five-star Zerg Destroyer could not affect that protective circle.

There was the core of the alien human army, the high-level commanders of the human race and their escort forces.

Since they could not defeat them, the Zerg Destroyer concentrated their strength on attacking other alien human forces and quickly eliminated their manpower.

"Boom...!"

Amid the continuous explosions, a thunder suddenly sounded, and a series of terrible lightning attacks fell on the defense line of the local camp army in the east, and suddenly opened a huge hole in the solid defense line!

The melee troops of the alien human army, which had an absolute advantage in overall combat strength, instantly broke through the hole and killed into the local camp army.

The two sides fought together. The super-long-range attacks of the Zerg Destroyer did not distinguish between enemies and friends, and there was no way to provide effective support. Now it depends on the true strength of the defending army!

"I miscalculated a bit. The number of Zerg Queens is still a little less!"

Wu Qing felt that one hundred five-star Zerg Queens were still not enough. The Zerg Queens who had been using their abilities constantly also needed time to recover.

"The attack ability of the human mages is strong. Kill the human mages hiding inside first!"

Wu Qing gave orders to some Zerg Queens who had recovered their ability to lay eggs.

There are also some human mages in the escort team of the mysterious human knight. They launched the powerful lightning magic attack just now.

Knights, mages, priests and some special personnel whose professions are not obvious. Wu Qing chose to kill mages first.

Wu Qing did not let the Zerg Queen attack the mysterious human knight because he was afraid of unpredictable changes. For the time being, he chose to be safe and try to eliminate this alien human army first and get this huge harvest.

The powerful group attack magic of the mages is too threatening to the local camp army that is blocking the alien human army from breaking through, and must be eliminated first.

The Zerg Queen launched a spawning attack on the target, everything was silent and no one noticed.

In the battles in the south and north, without the fire support of the Zerg Destroyer, the army of the local camp gradually fell behind, and the overall combat capability of the alien army was still much higher.

Even if the alien army lost most of its long-range arms, the army of the local camp still couldn't beat the melee arms of the alien army.

The combat power of the alien army is indeed very strong, with strong and balanced capabilities and almost no shortcomings.

If the Zerg army does not support, the alien armies in the south and north are very likely to break through the layers of defense and finally break out.

But the local army responsible for the defense in the east was even worse. It was directly broken through by a round of powerful lightning magic attacks, allowing a large number of melee arms of the alien army to rush over.

Just when they were worried that if there were a few more such magic attacks, the entire defense line would be breached, the human mages who were in the extremely powerful light attribute energy shield suddenly stopped casting spells!

The priest next to them noticed the abnormality of the mages and immediately used the purification magic on all the human mages.

The powerful purification magic did not alleviate the pain of the human mages, but made the situation worse.

The magical spores evolved into self-destructing parasites, which grew rapidly by feeding on the various energies and vitality of the host. A powerful purification energy suddenly surged into the human mages' bodies, which was equivalent to giving the self-destructing parasites a feast, making them grow faster.

"Pah pah pah...!"

Under the gaze of everyone, the human mages exploded one after another, exploded into a ray of light, disappeared, and only their belongings fell with them.

The Zerg Queen's spawning attack seemed to be an attack at the rule level. As long as it was within the killing range, it would definitely be a one-shot kill!

"Can you see anything?"

"It seems that a life has entered their bodies, absorbing energy and vitality to grow, and then self-destructing!"

"Is there any way to defend?"

"No attack method has been found yet, and it is impossible to effectively defend!"

"This attack should be limited, otherwise no one here can escape, so don't worry about it for now!"

The attack of the Zerg Queen is too magical. If you don't understand the attack principle, you can't defend it at all, so you can only ignore it temporarily.

The alien human breakout troops in the east, forced by the fierce attack of the Zerg destroyer, rushed into the army of the local camp through the gap opened by the human mage with lightning magic.

They would rather fight with the enemy than be bombed by the Zerg destroyer.
